observed_issue: The San component rendered without the initial crop box and initial input values.
root_cause: San initialized crop as an empty object but had no inited hook to copy initialCrop into crop, unlike the Vue created hook.

fix.added: inited() { const initialCrop = this.data.get('initialCrop'); this.data.set('crop', Object.assign({}, initialCrop)); }
fix.scope: Only the v2 San artifact was changed; Vue source and formal_30_v1 artifacts were not modified.

follow_up_issue: Changing a numeric parameter did not move or resize the crop box on the canvas.
follow_up_root_cause: The input handler passed `event` instead of San's `$event` expression, so update() did not receive the DOM event and crop remained unchanged.
lock_issue: The lock-aspect-ratio row did not match the Vue layout, and enabling the checkbox did not apply the aspect-ratio update.
lock_root_cause: The checkbox inherited the numeric-field grid layout, and the migrated Vue-style watch object was not registered by the San component runtime.

lock_fix.style: Added a dedicated lock-control flex row and placed the checkbox before the label text visually.
lock_fix.behavior: Registered this.watch('locked', ...) in inited() and removed the inactive Vue-style watch object.

manual_check.expected: Initial values should match x=10, y=10, width=45, height=55; edits should update the crop box immediately; enabling lock should update height from width and keep subsequent width edits proportional; the checkbox should appear before its label text.
